question: What was Paul's first plan for travelling to Corinth?
options: Visit Corinth only after returning from Judea
Go to Macedonia first and never come to Corinth
Visit Corinth on the way to Macedonia and again on the way back, then go to Judea
Go straight to Judea and then to Rome
explanation: Paul planned to visit the Corinthians on his way to Macedonia, come back to them from Macedonia, and then be sent on to Judea.
